# 84 -> 73 -> 96 -> 98. The dip was rc.6 emitting code for policy features the
# YAML did not use; the recovery was testing it anyway, white-box, because
# "unreachable through the factory" never meant "untestable" — the tests live in
# the same package. Then the policy grew its first `when:` predicate and the
# generated fact frame arrived, which is the same fail-closed contract one layer
# out: an absent, unparseable or out-of-bounds fact FAILS the decision rather
# than reporting the guard as unsatisfied. Covered before it shipped.
#
# What remains uncovered is two statements in Build that no input can reach:
# every operation in the vocabulary has a route, so the route.id == "" and
# route.reason == "" fallbacks for an unrouted operation cannot fire.
